description:
Cancel the pending friend request sent to 'ghost_pilot@example.com'. 

Starting from the Friends (home) page:
1. Navigate to the 'Add Friend' or 'Requests' section.
2. Locate the 'Sent Requests' tab or list.
3. Find the pending request for 'ghost_pilot@example.com'.
4. Tap the Cancel/Withdraw button to remove the request.
